_comment: C's proposed field vocabulary for profile.schema.json. B formalises this into the real schema and freezes it (INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md §1). Every field is nullable; null means 'not yet asked'. Derived from the actual criteria of the three MVP grants — no speculative fields.

is_incorporated.note: Gates the raiSE membership remedy chain. Distinct from previously_incorporated.

acra_uen.note: Not an eligibility criterion. Feeds B's ACRA lookup for verification.

raise_member.note: Blocking. Remedy depends on is_incorporated - raiSE requires an ACRA-registered business.

has_vwo_partnership.note: VWO / Voluntary Welfare Organisation. CONTEXT.md says 'SSO' - that appears to be an error, see SOURCES.md correction #3.

previously_incorporated.note: SSGF requires this to be false. Someone can be not-currently-incorporated but previously incorporated.

equity_pct.note: Must hold or propose to hold at least 30%.

received_other_gov_funding.note: Drives the YCM-then-SSGF sequencing warning. See INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md §4.

has_amp_lor.note: Letter of Recommendation from an Accredited Mentor Partner.

can_match_capital_sgd.note: 1:1 matching. Quantum figures are vendor-sourced only - see SOURCES.md.

project_duration_months.note: YCM projects must complete within 6 months of award.

has_disability.note: IMPACT METRICS AND ACCESSIBILITY ROUTING ONLY. Never a criterion in any rules file. No SG grant we found gates on disability status, and encoding one would be both wrong and indefensible on stage.

social_need.note: Free text from elicitation. Feeds drafting, not eligibility.

beneficiary_group.note: Free text from elicitation. Feeds drafting, not eligibility.
